name: deepscientist-codex
description: Native Codex CLI adapter for DeepScientist with vendored headless runtime, project-local quests, memory, artifacts, and dsctl scripts.

interface.shortDescription: Use DeepScientist research quests from Codex CLI through native dsctl scripts.
interface.longDescription: A self-contained Codex CLI plugin that embeds the retained headless DeepScientist runtime and exposes project-local quest, memory, artifact, paper, and experiment operations through scripts/dsctl.py.
defaultPrompt: Use DeepScientist Codex Native for research quest state. Load the deepscientist-codex skill, run scripts/dsctl.py doctor from the project root, and persist important results through dsctl calls.
